cohort: 100 neonates with apnea of prematurity (AOP) in a NICU, with 50 receiving caffeine citrate and 50 receiving aminophylline.
finding: Caffeine citrate was more effective than aminophylline in managing AOP, resulting in fewer and less severe apnea episodes, lower incidence of side effects, decreased need for mechanical ventilation, and shorter hospital stays.
gest_age: infants born before 34 weeks of gestation
followup_time: duration of hospital stay (average 22 days for caffeine group, 28 days for aminophylline group)
